segments.text: Ok so this is the Vue quickstart for Google ADK, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the Vue quickstart link just shows the ADK landing page.
And this is all there is, a prompt wizard, no install, runtime or agent steps.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
The whole runtime server and the agent wiring weren't on the page, so I wrote them myself.
Moving on to the demo. It should give me a working Vue app, but it only runs on the setup I built by hand.
So basically there's no Vue quickstart to follow at all, so every other page has nothing to build on.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
